exposure: requirement of labor augmentation with oxytocin
outcome: failed trial of labor after one previous caesarean section
cohort: 380 women with a history of one caesarean section who were booked for antenatal checkups and labor at the Pak Emirates Military Hospital in Rawalpindi, Pakistan.
finding: Gestational age > 40 weeks, poor Bishop score (<5) at admission, and requirement of labor augmentation were significantly associated with failed trial of labor in women with one previous caesarean section.
